name: vite-plugin-lit-ssr-example
description: Lit components server-rendered with @lit-labs/ssr by a Vite dev server and hydrated in the page, with @oddsquad/vite-plugin-lit hot-patching them. Opens on StackBlitz straight from the repo URL.
